commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): record the unwired headline, the sorried instances, and the rational-point decision
commits.summary: **Three findings from an adversarially-verified six-front assessment.** (1) `AJC.picrep.rigidpushforward` was marked done earlier today; that was wrong and is now `pending` — RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean:1386-1388 says in its own docstring that the `HasRigidPushforward` gate is not instantiated because its `baseChange` field is still open. (2) `Jacobian.lean` imports only `Genus`, so none of the 122k lines of Picard/Albanese/Cohomology work is reachable from `picardJacobianWitness`, and two `sorry`-bodied *instances* (`instHasPicScheme` at FGAPicRepresentability.lean:317, `pullback_preservesFiniteLimits` at CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean:163) leak through typeclass synthesis — so "153 sorry-free modules" is a local claim, not an axiom-cleanliness one. (3) The rational-point hypothesis is a design decision, not a platform limit: mathlib v4.31 does carry the étale topology.
